mission.requirement: WHEN the card number is any valid card number other than 4000000000000002, THE Application SHALL succeed payment processing after 800 milliseconds and display the Confirmation_Element

steps.thought: I want to pay this bill, so I'm looking for the button that starts paying. The screen is still blank, so I'll wait for something to appear.
I can see 'Pay this bill'. I'll tap it.
This page says 'Set up autopay'. It isn't where I meant to go. I'll tap 'Back to bill' to go back.

I can see 'Pay this bill'. I'll tap it again. Twice I tapped 'Pay this bill' and the page jumped just before my finger landed, so I ended up on a page that says 'Set up autopay' instead. I'm giving up.

findings.title: The click landed on a different element than the one aimed at
findings.evidence: Aimed at "Pay this bill" (seen at x 16, y 286, 152×48). 1.2 s later the click landed on "Set up autopay".
